text:
Alyssa Chen: Quick heads-up — I pulled the Q4->Q1 incident rolls and there are a few repeats we should catalogue and assign owners for. Want to close the loop on remediation ownership and acceptable timelines.
JP Ortiz: TL;DR from the raw list: top recurring causes = autoscaler flapping (7), prefix/KV cache invalidations (5), model load latency during rollouts (4), and a handful of transient image-pull/gke nodes (3).
Kim Park: +1 to catalogue. Can we create a tiny action table here? I can take ownership of autoscaler flapping remediation. Target: 3 weeks for root-cause + mitigation plan. :spiral_calendar:
Marta Singh: Suggest we prioritise by customer impact: autoscaler + model load latency first. I can own the model load rollout checklist and runbook updates. ETA: 2 weeks for checklist, 6 weeks for implementation and canary.
Rahul Verma: I’ll pick prefix/KV cache work. From the last PM, the immediate wins are: 1) add TTL tuning dashboard, 2) add eviction metrics to traces, 3) add unit test for cache miss storm. Plan: draft PR this week, QA next week.
Alyssa Chen: Great — want explicit action items so we can track in the postmortem follow-ups. Can folks paste a one-line action + owner + finish date here? I’ll synthesize into the incident tracker.
JP Ortiz: Action: Run autoscaler incident replay + add circuit-breaker + policy tweak; owner: Kim Park; finish: 2026-04-15.
Kim Park: Action: Autoscaler replay + proposal for circuit-breaker and backoff; owner: Kim Park; finish: 2026-04-15. I'll include a short sim harness.
Marta Singh: Action: Model-load rollout checklist + runbook + canary plan; owner: Marta Singh; finish: 2026-04-01 for checklist, 2026-05-15 for canary.
Rahul Verma: Action: Prefix/KV cache telemetry + eviction metric + unit tests; owner: Rahul Verma; finish: 2026-03-30.
Alyssa Chen: Action: Update postmortem tracker with 'recurring-pattern' tag and add cross-links to PMs. Owner: Alyssa Chen. Finish: 2026-03-26.
SRE Bot: Automated tally: recurring incidents tagged this review window = 19. New 'recurring-pattern' label created in tracker.
JP Ortiz: Quick note — some of the model-load cases only surface under long-tail seq lengths. We should include a perf regression guard in CI that hits 512+ seq lengths.
Marta Singh: Added: Action: CI perf guard for 512+ sequences during model onboarding; owner: Marta Singh; finish: 2026-04-10.
Kim Park: Also propose an Ops doc change: add a 'when to fallback' matrix so applications know when to switch to smaller model variant automatically. Quick draft by 2026-04-05. Owner: Kim Park.
Rahul Verma: One more thing — can we tag existing PMs with the incidents they contributed to? makes it easier to spot repeats. I can backfill tags for the last 6 months if people ok.
Alyssa Chen: Please do Rahul, that will help the RCA heatmap. I'll ask product to share customer-impacted endpoints list.
JP Ortiz: For visibility: link to the three PMs I referenced earlier -> https://internal.redwood/pm/INC-4187, INC-4210, INC-4332 (internal).
Marta Singh: Small risk note: the autoscaler fix may require a short maintenance window for the dedicated pool. We should coordinate with customers for any potential throttling.
Kim Park: OK — I'll draft a customer comms note and post it in #support when we have dates.
Alyssa Chen: Proposed cadence: monthly recurring-pattern triage meeting (30m) to close older action items and surface new repeats — who can commit?
JP Ortiz: I can commit monthly.
Marta Singh: I can do it too.
Rahul Verma: I’ll join for the cache/telemetry bits.
SRE Bot: Reminder created: recurring-pattern-triage monthly meeting scheduled on the 2nd Tue of each month.
Alyssa Chen: Last ask — please add your primary JIRA/ticket number when you create the remediation ticket and set a 1-week status update cadence. I will prod owners if updates miss their cadence.
Kim Park: Will do.
Marta Singh: Will do.
Rahul Verma: Will do.
Alyssa Chen: Perfect. I'll synthesize these into the incident tracker and ping the group when my doc is live. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
